test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-3) Official Paper (Held On: 17 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: As per the India State of Forest Report (ISFR) 2021, which among the following Union Territories of India has the highest cover with respect to its total geographical area?

options.text: Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu

solution:
The correct answer is **__Lakshadweep.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Union Territory of **Lakshadweep** has the front of the most elevated wood with 90.33%. Among states, Mizoram has the front of the most elevated woods with 85.41%.
 
• Concerning the level of wood cover: **Mizoram (85.41 percent) **is the most timberland-rich state.
 
• The States/Union Territories showed a bigger expansion in backwoods cover in Karnataka followed by Andhra Pradesh, Kerala, and Jammu and Kashmir.
 
• Andaman and Nicobar island has the most extreme woods cover region among the Union domains in India. it has an 86.93% timberland cover region.
 
• On Other hand, Lakshadweep has zero percent woods cover region.
 
• Starting around 2021, the absolute woods cover in India is** 713,789 sq km**, which is **21.71 percent** of the complete geological region.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Lakshadweep is also known as a union territory of India.
 
• It is an archipelago of 36 islands in the Arabian sea, located **200 to 440 km (120 to 270 mi)** off the Malabar Coast.
 
• Lakshadweep, formerly (1956–73) Laccadive, Minicoy, and Amindivi Islands, union territory of India.
